status: engine: gotmpl pages can declare native single-table sources. Authored queries: SQL stays available with its own read boundary: see api({at:'frontend'}) gotmpl_queries.
contract: sources: maps names to the same table/select/where/group_by/aggregates/order_by/limit spec as POST /api/_query, plus report-only tenant_scope: current and overflow: error options. Results always bind as lists at .sources.<name>, including limit: 1 and empty results. Source names are identifiers (up to 40 characters). A page may declare both `queries:` and `sources:`, but no query may be named `sources`. Unknown spec fields fail authoring validation. Values in where: are literal typed YAML values, never SQL or :param interpolation. No joins, computed expressions, SQL functions or dynamic bind syntax are accepted.
authorization: Each source uses the original HTTP caller and the complete native query path: table/connector access, credential scopes, membership/owner/group/ACL rows, soft-delete exclusion, encrypted source decoding and operation limits, role/owner masks, hidden columns and configured read-audit logging. A scoped credential is never a page's caller: a page with an auth, role or require gate answers it 403 `scoped_credential_page` before any source runs, and on a page without a gate each source answers it as it answers a signed-out request (api({at:'auth'}) credential_limits). Page scope: owner additionally ANDs user_id = the signed-in caller with those restrictions, including for aggregates and broader table access; it requires an authenticated caller and a user_id column. It cannot override an existing filter or native tenant scope.
tenant_scope: Optional tenant_scope: current adds the configured physical groups.key column = the original authenticated request's server-resolved effective tenant as a SQL parameter. It is ANDed with every native, owner and authored filter even for an administrator; acting-as uses the effective tenant. Missing identity is 401, no effective selected tenant is 403, and missing group-column metadata is 400. Unknown, blank or null enum values fail authoring validation. This never takes a tenant from URL/body/header/template input and never broadens access; omitting it keeps native admin and groupless-owner semantics, which may be broader than an authored SQL report's explicit tenant filter.
completeness: Optional overflow: error fetches at most one extra authorized result row beyond limit (default 200; explicit 1..1000) and refuses with HTTP 422 report_source_limit_exceeded before rendering any HTML when results exceed it. Errors are no-store. The cap counts result rows, including grouped rows; a COUNT(*) value is not a row count for this check. Invalid limits with this option fail authoring validation. For a complete bounded packet, use one source with tenant_scope: current, overflow: error and the desired limit, then render Documents: {{len .sources.documents}}. Empty results produce zero. Exactly the cap succeeds; larger packets are explicitly refused, not silently truncated. A separate COUNT plus list is not an atomic snapshot; pagination or a larger export needs its own reviewed completeness design.
errors: A denied, invalid or failed source stops the page before HTML is returned and preserves the native query error response/status (401/403/404/400 or sanitized 500), in production as well as development. It never silently renders an empty successful report. Each successfully executed source gets the existing query read-audit event; multiple sources are not an atomic snapshot.
example:
--- engine: gotmpl auth: required sources: contacts: table: contacts select: [name, status] where: {status: active} order_by: [{col: name, dir: asc}] limit: 100 --- {{range .sources.contacts}}

{{.name}}: {{.status}}

{{else}}

No contacts

{{end}}
migration: Move a compatible single-table report from queries: into sources: and change template access to .sources.<name>; singleton reports use range or an explicit length check. Keep confidential reads on native access rules. Preserve an extra current-tenant report restriction explicitly with tenant_scope: current; native owner/group defaults alone do not reproduce it for admin or groupless identities. Using overflow: error and a list-derived count replaces an unbounded packet with a complete bounded packet that clearly refuses excess rows; choose that change deliberately. Ordinary ciphertext-looking text stays literal, and only configured encrypted source fields decrypt under the existing mask policy. Reports needing joins or computed SQL require separate design and review; legacy queries: on the page mask, audit and fail visibly too, but owner and tenant unmask there need provable query shapes (api({at:'encryption'}) authored_page_queries). No global strict mode, storage migration or decoder change is included.
